history_summary.summary: The free-data lanes with plausible edge have been worked hard. The remaining attractive ideas require new PIT structured data rather than another rule threshold: parsed ownership events, historical filer-status cover pages, full-window options chains, borrow-fee history, or structured customer/supplier economics.

The advertising efficiency improvement source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested explicit raw SEC advertising / selling-marketing intensity improvement plus liquid SPY-relative confirmation. It is not retained or promoted.

The alpha idea is stronger than another SEC item-code retry, but the repository does not currently have the needed PIT historical 10-K/10-Q cover-page filer-status field. The SEC text snapshots are locally 8-K-oriented, while submissions metadata has 10-K/10-Q pointers but only a current top-level category. Treating that current category as historical would leak future state and break production/backtest consistency.

The PIT intra-industry lead-lag direction-stability source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high). The relation gate was intended to keep only tickers where prior completed leader events predicted positive 10-day excess return, but the fixed bundle still produced aggregate EV +1.2216, PnL $+17,008.11, and max drawdown drift +0.0363. By window: late_strong dEV +0.7748/dPnL $+11,449.91; mid_weak dEV +0.5964/dPnL $+10,740.65; old_thin dEV -0.1496/dPnL $-5,182.45. Economic reading: free-OHLCV lead-lag history is too noisy as a standalone always-on source; ticker-specific direction stability does not reliably distinguish diffusion from leader reversal or persistent laggard weakness across regimes.

The current strongest alpha lead is not absent; it is DPO extension, but it already failed the hard drawdown guard. The only credible non-repeat rescue checked here, PIT crowding/provenance context, is not available across the fixed windows: 13F is latest-only, FINRA/FTD requires a new borrow-cost/availability feed, options are forward-only, and SEC item/text plus raw Companyfacts relief neighbors are frozen or recently rejected. Launching another replay today would be a near-neighbor retune or a production/backtest mismatch.

The SEC NT late-filing notice absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_sample_too_small, target_window_coverage_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested NT 10-K/NT 10-Q late-filing notice forms plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.

The SBC grant-value backlog relief source had positive aggregate EV/PnL, but did not clear Gate 4 because the effect was narrow and unstable: old_thin regressed -0.0278 EV and $-1,091.19, while positive PnL was dominated by too few names (max single positive share 84.87%, HHI 0.7432). It also failed the accepted distribution and accepted SBC comparators, so the unrecognized backlog decline is more likely capturing sparse seasonal vesting decay in already-strong growth names than a robust incremental dilution-quality edge. Do not promote or tune this fixed grant-value normalization bundle on the same frozen windows.

The fixed 13D activist-stake bundle failed Gate 4. The most likely reasons are a thin declared-universe sample (large activist targets are rarer and better covered), the filing pop being priced before next-open paper entry, or window instability that the accepted comparator does not have.

The fixed 13G passive-stake bundle failed Gate 4. The most likely reasons are that 13G filings are annual/batch and often stale by the filing date, issuer-level first-in-archive events lose holder-level information, and the liquid momentum/core-overlap envelope admits mostly already-priced large-cap ownership confirmations rather than fresh edge.
